description:
Replace the per-command list-envelope tests with one schema-driven test that covers each list-emitting command.

## Background

`ListEnvelope` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs`) derives `count` from its collection on serialize and rejects a mismatch on deserialize. Each list-emitting command, found from its emission site, declares a typed output schema in the generated CLI schema (`CommandSchema::generate()`). `crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/list_envelope_tests.rs` asserts `count == len` in 19 per-command subprocess tests, covering `issue list`, the `query` family, `issue search`, `search`, `gate list`, `gate preset list`, `events tail` and `events query`, `doc list`, `doc assets list`, `claim list`, `label namespaces` and `label values`, `item list` and `item search`, `worktree list`, `worktree store-divergence`, `graph roots` and `graph rdeps`, `invariant check`, multi-id `issue show`, `graph deps` and `gate status-all`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One test enumerates the list-emitting commands from the generated schema, meaning commands whose output schema carries `count` beside a collection. It runs each on a seeded repository through the shared CLI process fixture and asserts that `count` equals the collection's length.
- [hard] REQ-02: The test fails and names the command when a list-emitting command in the schema has no invocation in it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Its invocations cover each command the 19 per-command cases covered, plus `claim status`, `project render` and the three `archive` commands.
- [hard] REQ-04: Independently of the schema, the test fails and names the command when an invocation's JSON body carries `count` beside an array while that command's schema output is the untyped fallback.
- [hard] REQ-05: The 19 per-command cases of `list_envelope_tests.rs` no longer exist.
title: One test proves the list-envelope count for each list-emitting command
